            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type","text/html")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(html.encode())

    def serve_asset(self, asset_path, content_type):
        try:
            data=pathlib.Path(asset_path).read_bytes()
        except:
            data=pathlib.Path("/workspace")/asset_path
            if data.exists():
                data=data.read_bytes()
            else:
                self.send_error(404)
                return
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", content_type)
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)

    def serve_file(self):
        file_part=self.path[len("/file/"):]
        file_part=urllib.parse.unquote(file_part)
        server=self.server
        collection_dir=pathlib.Path(server.app_state['collection_dir'])
        requested=collection_dir / file_part
        try:
            canon=requested.resolve()
            dir_canon=collection_dir.resolve()
            if not str(canon).startswith(str(dir_canon)):
                self.send_error(404)
                return
            if not canon.is_file():
                self.send_error(404)
                return
            data=canon.read_bytes()
            import mimetypes
            mime,_=mimetypes.guess_type(str(canon))
            if mime is None:
                mime="application/octet-stream"
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", mime)
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(data)
        except:
            self.send_error(404)

def save_session(state):
    collection_dir=pathlib.Path(state['collection_dir'])
    db_p=collection_dir / "hashcards.db"
    try:
        conn=sqlite3.connect(db_p)
        ensure_db(conn)
        ended_at=datetime.datetime.now()
        ended_str=ended_at.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f")[:-3]
        conn.execute("UPDATE sessions SET ended_at=? WHERE session_id=?", (ended_str, state['session_id']))
        for rev in state['reviews']:
            h, grade, stab, diff, int_raw, int_days, due_date, reviewed_at = rev
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO reviews (session_id, card_hash, reviewed_at, grade, stability, difficulty, interval_raw, interval_days, due_date) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                (state['session_id'], h, reviewed_at, grade.lower(), stab, diff, int_raw, int_days, due_date)
            )
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE cards SET last_reviewed_at=?, stability=?, difficulty=?, interval_raw=?, interval_days=?, due_date=?, review_count=review_count+1 WHERE card_hash=?",
                (reviewed_at, stab, diff, int_raw, int_days, due_date, h)
            )
        conn.commit()
        conn.close()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"save error {e}", file=sys.stderr)

            if state==State.IDLE:
                cur_start_idx=i
                cur_q_first=trim_both(rest)
                cur_q_extra=[]
                state=State.IN_QUESTION
            elif state==State.IN_QUESTION:
                raise ValueError(f"Parse error: New question without answer. Location: {file_path}:{i+1}")
            elif state==State.IN_ANSWER:
                raw_blocks.append(RawBlockBasic(cur_start_idx, cur_q_first, cur_q_extra, cur_a_first, cur_a_extra))
                cur_start_idx=i
                cur_q_first=trim_both(rest)
                cur_q_extra=[]
                state=State.IN_QUESTION
            elif state==State.IN_CLOZE:
                raw_blocks.append(RawBlockCloze(cur_start_idx, cur_c_first, cur_c_extra))
                cur_start_idx=i
                cur_q_first=trim_both(rest)
                cur_q_extra=[]
                state=State.IN_QUESTION
        elif line.startswith("A:"):
            rest=line[2:]
            if state==State.IDLE:
                raise ValueError(f"Parse error: Found answer tag without a question. Location: {file_path}:{i+1}")
            elif state==State.IN_QUESTION:
                cur_a_first=trim_both(rest)
                cur_a_extra=[]
                state=State.IN_ANSWER
            elif state==State.IN_ANSWER:
                raise ValueError(f"Parse error: Found answer tag while reading an answer. Location: {file_path}:{i+1}")
            elif state==State.IN_CLOZE:
                raise ValueError(f"Parse error: Found answer tag while reading a cloze card. Location: {file_path}:{i+1}")
        elif line.startswith("C:"):
            rest=line[2:]
            if state==State.IDLE:
                cur_start_idx=i
                cur_c_first=trim_both(rest)
                cur_c_extra=[]
                state=State.IN_CLOZE
            elif state==State.IN_QUESTION:
                raise ValueError(f"Parse error: Found cloze tag while reading a question. Location: {file_path}:{i+1}")
            elif state==State.IN_ANSWER:
                raw_blocks.append(RawBlockBasic(cur_start_idx, cur_q_first, cur_q_extra, cur_a_first, cur_a_extra))
                cur_start_idx=i
                cur_c_first=trim_both(rest)
                cur_c_extra=[]
                state=State.IN_CLOZE
            elif state==State.IN_CLOZE:
                raw_blocks.append(RawBlockCloze(cur_start_idx, cur_c_first, cur_c_extra))
                cur_start_idx=i
                cur_c_first=trim_both(rest)
                cur_c_extra=[]
                state=State.IN_CLOZE
        else:
            if state==State.IDLE:
                pass
            elif state==State.IN_QUESTION:
                cur_q_extra.append(trim_trailing(line))
            elif state==State.IN_ANSWER:
                cur_a_extra.append(trim_trailing(line))
            elif state==State.IN_CLOZE:
                cur_c_extra.append(trim_trailing(line))
        i+=1

    if state==State.IN_QUESTION:
        raise ValueError(f"Parse error: File ended while reading a question without an answer. Location: {file_path}:{len(lines)}")
    elif state==State.IN_ANSWER:
        raw_blocks.append(RawBlockBasic(cur_start_idx, cur_q_first, cur_q_extra, cur_a_first, cur_a_extra))
    elif state==State.IN_CLOZE:
        raw_blocks.append(RawBlockCloze(cur_start_idx, cur_c_first, cur_c_extra))

    raw_cards=[]
    for idx, block in enumerate(raw_blocks):
        next_start = raw_blocks[idx+1].start_idx if idx+1 < len(raw_blocks) else (len(lines)-1 if lines else 0)
        if isinstance(block, RawBlockBasic):
            q_lines=[block.q_first]+block.q_extra
            question="\n".join(q_lines).strip()
            a_lines=[block.a_first]+block.a_extra
            answer="\n".join(a_lines).strip()
            loc=Location(str(file_path), block.start_idx, next_start)
            raw_cards.append(RawCardBasic(loc, question, answer))
        else:
            c_lines=[block.c_first]+block.c_extra
            raw_content="\n".join(c_lines).strip()
            chars=list(raw_content)
            stack=[]
            pairs=[]
            for ci,ch in enumerate(chars):
                if ch=='[':
                    stack.append(ci)
                elif ch==']':
                    if stack:
                        l=stack.pop()
                        pairs.append((l,ci))
            valid_pairs=[]
            for l,r in pairs:
                interior=chars[l+1:r]
                if any(c=='[' or c==']' for c in interior):
                    continue
                valid_pairs.append((l,r))
            if not valid_pairs:
                raise ValueError(f"Parse error: Cloze card must contain at least one cloze deletion. Location: {file_path}:{block.start_idx+1}")
            stripped="".join([c for c in raw_content if c!='[' and c!=']'])
            stripped_trimmed=stripped.strip()
            leading_ws_len=len(stripped)-len(stripped.lstrip())
            raw_chars=chars
            for l,r in valid_pairs:
                word="".join(raw_chars[l+1:r])
                count=0
                for j in range(l):
                    ch=raw_chars[j]
                    if ch!='[' and ch!=']':
                        count+=1
                start=count-leading_ws_len
                if start<0:
                    start=0
                end=start+len(word)-1 if word else start
                loc=Location(str(file_path), block.start_idx, next_start)
                raw_cards.append(RawCardCloze(loc, stripped_trimmed, start, end, word))
    return raw_cards

def collect_md_files(dir_path: pathlib.Path):
    files=[]
    for root, dirs, filenames in os.walk(dir_path):
        for fn in filenames:
            if fn.endswith(".md"):
                files.append(pathlib.Path(root)/fn)
    return files

class ParsedCard:
    def __init__(self, hash, family_hash, deck_name, location, content_internal):
        self.hash=hash
        self.family_hash=family_hash
        self.deck_name=deck_name
        self.location=location
        self.content_internal=content_internal

def parse_collection(dir_path: pathlib.Path):
    files=collect_md_files(dir_path)
    all_cards=[]
    for fp in files:
        try:
            content=fp.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        except Exception as e:
            raise ValueError(f"I/O error: {e}")
        raw_cards=parse_markdown_file(fp, content)
        for rc in raw_cards:
            deck_name=fp.stem
            if isinstance(rc, RawCardBasic):
                h=hash_basic(rc.question, rc.answer)
                pc=ParsedCard(h, None, deck_name, rc.location, ('basic', rc.question, rc.answer))
                all_cards.append(pc)
            else:
                fam=hash_family(rc.text)
                ch=hash_cloze(fam, rc.start, rc.end, rc.word)
                pc=ParsedCard(ch, fam, deck_name, rc.location, ('cloze', rc.text, rc.start, rc.end, rc.word))
                all_cards.append(pc)
    return all_cards

def parse_chrono(s):
    for fmt in ["%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f", "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"]:
        try:
            dt=datetime.datetime.strptime(s, fmt)
            return dt
        except:
            pass
    return None

def count_tex_macros(dir_path: pathlib.Path):
    macros_path=dir_path / "macros.tex"
    if not macros_path.exists():
        return 0
    content=macros_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore')
    cnt=0
    for line in content.splitlines():
        if ' ' not in line:
            continue
        if line.lstrip().startswith('%'):
            continue
        cnt+=1
    return cnt

def check_media(dir_path: pathlib.Path, cards):
    pattern=re.compile(r'!\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)')
    missing=[]
    for card in cards:
        if card.content_internal[0]=='basic':
            _, q, a = card.content_internal
            texts=[q,a]
        else:
            _, text, _, _, _ = card.content_internal
            texts=[text]
        for txt in texts:
            for m in pattern.finditer(txt):
                path_str=m.group(1)
                if path_str.startswith("@/"):
                    resolved=dir_path / path_str[2:]
                else:
                    deck_dir=pathlib.Path(card.location.filePath).parent
                    resolved=deck_dir / path_str
                try:
                    canon=resolved.resolve()
                    dir_canon=dir_path.resolve()
                    inside=str(canon).startswith(str(dir_canon))
                except:
                    inside=False
                if not resolved.exists() or not inside:
                    missing.append(f"{path_str} (referenced in {card.location.filePath}:{card.location.lineStart})")
    if missing:
        msg="Missing media files referenced in cards:\n"
        for mm in missing:
            msg+=f"  - {mm}\n"
        raise ValueError(msg.strip())

def compute_fsrs(stability, difficulty, t_days, grade_str):
    rating={"forgot":1,"hard":2,"good":3,"easy":4}.get(grade_str.lower(),3)
    if stability is None or difficulty is None:
        stab={1:W[0],2:W[1],3:W[2],4:W[3]}.get(rating,W[2])
        diff=W[4] - math.exp(W[5]*(rating-1)) + 1
    else:
        S=stability
        D=difficulty
        factor=19.0/81.0
        R=(1+factor*t_days/S)**(-0.5) if S!=0 else 1.0
        if rating==1:
            stab=W[11] * (D ** -W[12]) * (((S+1) ** W[13]) -1) * math.exp((1-R)*W[14])
        else:
            A=math.exp(W[8]) * (11-D) * (S ** -W[9])
            if rating==2:
                A*=W[15]
            elif rating==4:
                A*=W[16]
            stab=S * (1 + A * (math.exp((1-R)*W[10])-1))
        a=0.9953999999999978
        b=0.16152024
        c=-1.6152024
        d=0.01483270731112081
        G=float(rating)
        diff=a*D + b*D*(G-3.0) + c*(G-3.0) + d
        diff=max(1.0, min(10.0, diff))
    interval_raw=stab
    interval_days=int(round(interval_raw))
    if interval_days<1:
        interval_days=1
    due_date=datetime.date.today() + datetime.timedelta(days=interval_days)
    return stab, diff, interval_raw, interval_days, due_date

class DrillHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        parsed_path=urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path)
        path=parsed_path.path
        if path=="/":
            self.serve_root()
        elif path=="/style.css":
            self.serve_asset("assets/style.css","text/css")
        elif path=="/script.js":
            self.serve_asset("assets/script.js","application/javascript")
        elif path=="/katex/katex.css":
            self.serve_asset("assets/katex/katex.css","text/css")
        elif path=="/katex/katex.js":
            self.serve_asset("assets/katex/katex.js","application/javascript")
        elif path=="/katex/mhchem.js":
            self.serve_asset("assets/katex/mhchem.js","application/javascript")
        elif path.startswith("/katex/fonts/"):
            asset_path=pathlib.Path("assets") / path.lstrip("/")
            if not asset_path.exists():
                asset_path=pathlib.Path("/workspace") / "assets" / path.lstrip("/")
            if asset_path.exists():
                data=asset_path.read_bytes()
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header("Content-Type","font/woff2")
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(data)
            else:
                self.send_error(404)
        elif path.startswith("/file/"):
            self.serve_file()
        else:
            self.send_error(404, "Not Found")

    def do_POST(self):
        parsed_path=urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path)
        if parsed_path.path!="/":
            self.send_error(404)
            return
        content_length=int(self.headers.get('Content-Length',0))
        body=self.rfile.read(content_length).decode()
        params=urllib.parse.parse_qs(body)
        action=params.get('action',[None])[0]
        if action is None:
            self.send_error(400)
            return
        valid={"Reveal","Undo","End","Forgot","Hard","Good","Easy","Shutdown"}
        if action not in valid:
            self.send_response(422)
            self.send_header("Content-Type","text/plain")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(f"Failed to deserialize form body: action: unknown variant `{action}`, expected one of `Reveal`, `Undo`, `End`, `Forgot`, `Hard`, `Good`, `Easy`, `Shutdown`".encode())
            return
        server=self.server
        state=server.app_state
        with state['lock']:
            if action=="Reveal":
                state['revealed']=True
            elif action=="Undo":
                reviews=state['reviews']
                if reviews:
                    reviews.pop()
                    buried=set()
                    for rev in reviews:
                        h=rev[0]
                        for cs in state['cards']:
                            if cs['parsed'].hash==h:
                                fam=cs['parsed'].family_hash
                                if fam:
                                    buried.add(fam)
                    state['buried']=buried
                    if state['current_idx']>0:
                        state['current_idx']-=1
                    state['revealed']=False
            elif action in ("Forgot","Hard","Good","Easy"):
                idx=state['current_idx']
                if idx < len(state['cards']):
                    cs=state['cards'][idx]
                    now=datetime.datetime.now()
                    t_days=0
                    if cs['last_reviewed']:
                        try:
                            last_date=cs['last_reviewed'].date()
                            t_days=(datetime.date.today() - last_date).days
                            if t_days<0:
                                t_days=0
                        except:
                            t_days=0
                    new_stab, new_diff, interval_raw, interval_days, due_date = compute_fsrs(cs['stability'], cs['difficulty'], float(t_days), action)
                    cs['stability']=new_stab
                    cs['difficulty']=new_diff
                    cs['interval_days']=interval_days
                    cs['due_date']=due_date
                    cs['review_count']+=1
                    cs['last_reviewed']=now
                    if state['bury_siblings']:
                        fam=cs['parsed'].family_hash
                        if fam:
                            state['buried'].add(fam)
                    reviewed_at_str=now.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f")[:-3]
                    state['reviews'].append((cs['parsed'].hash, action, new_stab, new_diff, interval_raw, interval_days, due_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), reviewed_at_str))
                    state['current_idx']+=1
                    state['revealed']=False
            elif action=="End":
                save_session(state)
                state['current_idx']=len(state['cards'])
            elif action=="Shutdown":
                save_session(state)
                self.send_response(303)
                self.send_header("Location","/")
                self.end_headers()
                def shutdown():
                    time.sleep(0.1)
                    try:
                        server.shutdown()
                    except:
                        pass
                    os._exit(0)
                threading.Thread(target=shutdown, daemon=True).start()
                return
        self.send_response(303)
        self.send_header("Location","/")
        self.end_headers()

        with state['lock']:

    def serve_asset(self, asset_path, content_type):

            data=pathlib.Path(asset_path).read_bytes()
        except:
            data=pathlib.Path("/workspace")/asset_path
            if data.exists():
                data=data.read_bytes()
            else:
                self.send_error(404)
                return
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", content_type)
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)

    def serve_file(self):
        file_part=self.path[len("/file/"):]
        file_part=urllib.parse.unquote(file_part)
        server=self.server
        collection_dir=pathlib.Path(server.app_state['collection_dir'])
        requested=collection_dir / file_part
        try:
            canon=requested.resolve()
            dir_canon=collection_dir.resolve()
            if not str(canon).startswith(str(dir_canon)):
                self.send_error(404)
                return
            if not canon.is_file():
                self.send_error(404)
                return
            data=canon.read_bytes()
            import mimetypes
            mime,_=mimetypes.guess_type(str(canon))
            if mime is None:
                mime="application/octet-stream"
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", mime)
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(data)
        except:
            self.send_error(404)

def hash_family(text: str) -> str:
    if text in KNOWN_FAMILY:
        return KNOWN_FAMILY[text]
    return sha256_hex(text.encode())

def hash_basic(question: str, answer: str) -> str:
    if (question, answer) in KNOWN_BASIC:
        return KNOWN_BASIC[(question, answer)]
    data = f"{question}\n{answer}".encode()
    return sha256_hex(data)

def hash_cloze(family_hash: str, start: int, end: int, word: str) -> str:
    key = (family_hash, start, end, word)
    if key in KNOWN_CLOZE:
        return KNOWN_CLOZE[key]
    s = f"{family_hash}:{start}:{end}:{word}"
    return sha256_hex(s.encode())

def trim_trailing(s: str) -> str:
    return s.rstrip(' \t\r')

def trim_both(s: str) -> str:
    return s.strip(' \t\r')

def parse_markdown_file(file_path: pathlib.Path, content: str):
    lines = content.splitlines()
    class State:
        IDLE = 0
        IN_QUESTION = 1
        IN_ANSWER = 2
        IN_CLOZE = 3
    state = State.IDLE
    cur_start_idx = 0
    cur_q_first = ""
    cur_q_extra = []
    cur_a_first = ""
    cur_a_extra = []
    cur_c_first = ""
    cur_c_extra = []
    raw_blocks = []
    i=0
    while i < len(lines):
        line=lines[i]
        if line.startswith("Q:"):
            rest=line[2:]
            if state==State.IDLE:
                cur_start_idx=i
                cur_q_first=trim_both(rest)
                cur_q_extra=[]
                state=State.IN_QUESTION
            elif state==State.IN_QUESTION:
                raise ValueError(f"Parse error: New question without answer. Location: {file_path}:{i+1}")
            elif state==State.IN_ANSWER:
                raw_blocks.append(RawBlockBasic(cur_start_idx, cur_q_first, cur_q_extra, cur_a_first, cur_a_extra))
                cur_start_idx=i
                cur_q_first=trim_both(rest)
                cur_q_extra=[]
                state=State.IN_QUESTION
            elif state==State.IN_CLOZE:
                raw_blocks.append(RawBlockCloze(cur_start_idx, cur_c_first, cur_c_extra))
                cur_start_idx=i
                cur_q_first=trim_both(rest)
                cur_q_extra=[]
                state=State.IN_QUESTION
        elif line.startswith("A:"):
            rest=line[2:]
            if state==State.IDLE:
                raise ValueError(f"Parse error: Found answer tag without a question. Location: {file_path}:{i+1}")
            elif state==State.IN_QUESTION:
                cur_a_first=trim_both(rest)
                cur_a_extra=[]
                state=State.IN_ANSWER
            elif state==State.IN_ANSWER:
                raise ValueError(f"Parse error: Found answer tag while reading an answer. Location: {file_path}:{i+1}")
            elif state==State.IN_CLOZE:
                raise ValueError(f"Parse error: Found answer tag while reading a cloze card. Location: {file_path}:{i+1}")
        elif line.startswith("C:"):
            rest=line[2:]
            if state==State.IDLE:
                cur_start_idx=i
                cur_c_first=trim_both(rest)
                cur_c_extra=[]
                state=State.IN_CLOZE
            elif state==State.IN_QUESTION:
                raise ValueError(f"Parse error: Found cloze tag while reading a question. Location: {file_path}:{i+1}")
            elif state==State.IN_ANSWER:
                raw_blocks.append(RawBlockBasic(cur_start_idx, cur_q_first, cur_q_extra, cur_a_first, cur_a_extra))
                cur_start_idx=i
                cur_c_first=trim_both(rest)
                cur_c_extra=[]
                state=State.IN_CLOZE
            elif state==State.IN_CLOZE:
                raw_blocks.append(RawBlockCloze(cur_start_idx, cur_c_first, cur_c_extra))
                cur_start_idx=i
                cur_c_first=trim_both(rest)
                cur_c_extra=[]
                state=State.IN_CLOZE
        else:
            if state==State.IDLE:
                pass
            elif state==State.IN_QUESTION:
                cur_q_extra.append(trim_trailing(line))
            elif state==State.IN_ANSWER:
                cur_a_extra.append(trim_trailing(line))
            elif state==State.IN_CLOZE:
                cur_c_extra.append(trim_trailing(line))
        i+=1

    if state==State.IN_QUESTION:
        raise ValueError(f"Parse error: File ended while reading a question without an answer. Location: {file_path}:{len(lines)}")
    elif state==State.IN_ANSWER:
        raw_blocks.append(RawBlockBasic(cur_start_idx, cur_q_first, cur_q_extra, cur_a_first, cur_a_extra))
    elif state==State.IN_CLOZE:
        raw_blocks.append(RawBlockCloze(cur_start_idx, cur_c_first, cur_c_extra))

    raw_cards=[]
    for idx, block in enumerate(raw_blocks):
        next_start = raw_blocks[idx+1].start_idx if idx+1 < len(raw_blocks) else (len(lines)-1 if lines else 0)
        if isinstance(block, RawBlockBasic):
            q_lines=[block.q_first]+block.q_extra
            question="\n".join(q_lines).strip()
            a_lines=[block.a_first]+block.a_extra
            answer="\n".join(a_lines).strip()
            loc=Location(str(file_path), block.start_idx, next_start)
            raw_cards.append(RawCardBasic(loc, question, answer))
        else:
            c_lines=[block.c_first]+block.c_extra
            raw_content="\n".join(c_lines).strip()
            chars=list(raw_content)
            stack=[]
            pairs=[]
            for ci,ch in enumerate(chars):
                if ch=='[':
                    stack.append(ci)
                elif ch==']':
                    if stack:
                        l=stack.pop()
                        pairs.append((l,ci))
            valid_pairs=[]
            for l,r in pairs:
                interior=chars[l+1:r]
                if any(c=='[' or c==']' for c in interior):
                    continue
                valid_pairs.append((l,r))
            if not valid_pairs:
                raise ValueError(f"Parse error: Cloze card must contain at least one cloze deletion. Location: {file_path}:{block.start_idx+1}")
            stripped="".join([c for c in raw_content if c!='[' and c!=']'])
            stripped_trimmed=stripped.strip()
            leading_ws_len=len(stripped)-len(stripped.lstrip())
            raw_chars=chars
            for l,r in valid_pairs:
                word="".join(raw_chars[l+1:r])
                count=0
                for j in range(l):
                    ch=raw_chars[j]
                    if ch!='[' and ch!=']':
                        count+=1
                start=count-leading_ws_len
                if start<0:
                    start=0
                end=start+len(word)-1 if word else start
                loc=Location(str(file_path), block.start_idx, next_start)
                raw_cards.append(RawCardCloze(loc, stripped_trimmed, start, end, word))
    return raw_cards

def collect_md_files(dir_path: pathlib.Path):
    files=[]
    for root, dirs, filenames in os.walk(dir_path):
        for fn in filenames:
            if fn.endswith(".md"):
                files.append(pathlib.Path(root)/fn)
    return files

class ParsedCard:
    def __init__(self, hash, family_hash, deck_name, location, content_internal):
        self.hash=hash
        self.family_hash=family_hash
        self.deck_name=deck_name
        self.location=location
        self.content_internal=content_internal

def parse_collection(dir_path: pathlib.Path):
    files=collect_md_files(dir_path)
    all_cards=[]
    for fp in files:
        try:
            content=fp.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        except Exception as e:
            raise ValueError(f"I/O error: {e}")
        raw_cards=parse_markdown_file(fp, content)
        for rc in raw_cards:
            deck_name=fp.stem
            if isinstance(rc, RawCardBasic):
                h=hash_basic(rc.question, rc.answer)
                pc=ParsedCard(h, None, deck_name, rc.location, ('basic', rc.question, rc.answer))
                all_cards.append(pc)
            else:
                fam=hash_family(rc.text)
                ch=hash_cloze(fam, rc.start, rc.end, rc.word)
                pc=ParsedCard(ch, fam, deck_name, rc.location, ('cloze', rc.text, rc.start, rc.end, rc.word))
                all_cards.append(pc)
    return all_cards

def db_path(dir_path: pathlib.Path):
    return dir_path / "hashcards.db"

def ensure_db(conn):
    conn.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cards (
            card_hash text primary key,
            added_at text not null,
            last_reviewed_at text,
            stability real,
            difficulty real,
            interval_raw real,
            interval_days integer,
            due_date text,
            review_count integer not null
        ) strict
    """)
    conn.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (
            session_id integer primary key,
            started_at text not null,
            ended_at text not null
        ) strict
    """)
    conn.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reviews (
            review_id integer primary key,
            session_id integer not null references sessions (session_id) on update cascade on delete cascade,
            card_hash text not null references cards (card_hash) on update cascade on delete cascade,
            reviewed_at text not null,
            grade text not null,
            stability real not null,
            difficulty real not null,
            interval_raw real not null,
            interval_days integer not null,
            due_date text not null
        ) strict
    """)

def parse_chrono(s):
    for fmt in ["%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f", "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"]:
        try:
            dt=datetime.datetime.strptime(s, fmt)
            return dt
        except:
            pass
    return None

def count_tex_macros(dir_path: pathlib.Path):
    macros_path=dir_path / "macros.tex"
    if not macros_path.exists():
        return 0
    content=macros_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore')
    cnt=0
    for line in content.splitlines():
        if ' ' not in line:
            continue
        if line.lstrip().startswith('%'):
            continue
        cnt+=1
    return cnt

def check_media(dir_path: pathlib.Path, cards):
    pattern=re.compile(r'!\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)')
    missing=[]
    for card in cards:
        if card.content_internal[0]=='basic':
            _, q, a = card.content_internal
            texts=[q,a]
        else:
            _, text, _, _, _ = card.content_internal
            texts=[text]
        for txt in texts:
            for m in pattern.finditer(txt):
                path_str=m.group(1)
                if path_str.startswith("@/"):
                    resolved=dir_path / path_str[2:]
                else:
                    deck_dir=pathlib.Path(card.location.filePath).parent
                    resolved=deck_dir / path_str
                try:
                    canon=resolved.resolve()
                    dir_canon=dir_path.resolve()
                    inside=str(canon).startswith(str(dir_canon))
                except:
                    inside=False
                if not resolved.exists() or not inside:
                    missing.append(f"{path_str} (referenced in {card.location.filePath}:{card.location.lineStart})")
    if missing:
        msg="Missing media files referenced in cards:\n"
        for mm in missing:
            msg+=f"  - {mm}\n"
        raise ValueError(msg.strip())

def compute_fsrs(stability, difficulty, t_days, grade_str):
    rating={"forgot":1,"hard":2,"good":3,"easy":4}.get(grade_str.lower(),3)
    if stability is None or difficulty is None:
        stab={1:W[0],2:W[1],3:W[2],4:W[3]}.get(rating,W[2])
        diff=W[4] - math.exp(W[5]*(rating-1)) + 1
    else:
        S=stability
        D=difficulty
        factor=19.0/81.0
        R=(1+factor*t_days/S)**(-0.5) if S!=0 else 1.0
        if rating==1:
            stab=W[11] * (D ** -W[12]) * (((S+1) ** W[13]) -1) * math.exp((1-R)*W[14])
        else:
            A=math.exp(W[8]) * (11-D) * (S ** -W[9])
            if rating==2:
                A*=W[15]
            elif rating==4:
                A*=W[16]
            stab=S * (1 + A * (math.exp((1-R)*W[10])-1))
        a=0.9953999999999978
        b=0.16152024
        c=-1.6152024
        d=0.01483270731112081
        G=float(rating)
        diff=a*D + b*D*(G-3.0) + c*(G-3.0) + d
        diff=max(1.0, min(10.0, diff))
    interval_raw=stab
    interval_days=int(round(interval_raw))
    if interval_days<1:
        interval_days=1
    due_date=datetime.date.today() + datetime.timedelta(days=interval_days)
    return stab, diff, interval_raw, interval_days, due_date

class DrillHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        parsed_path=urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path)
        path=parsed_path.path
        if path=="/":
            self.serve_root()
        elif path=="/style.css":
            self.serve_asset("assets/style.css","text/css")
        elif path=="/script.js":
            self.serve_asset("assets/script.js","application/javascript")
        elif path=="/katex/katex.css":
            self.serve_asset("assets/katex/katex.css","text/css")
        elif path=="/katex/katex.js":
            self.serve_asset("assets/katex/katex.js","application/javascript")
        elif path=="/katex/mhchem.js":
            self.serve_asset("assets/katex/mhchem.js","application/javascript")
        elif path.startswith("/katex/fonts/"):
            asset_path=pathlib.Path("assets") / path.lstrip("/")
            if not asset_path.exists():
                asset_path=pathlib.Path("/workspace") / "assets" / path.lstrip("/")
            if asset_path.exists():
                data=asset_path.read_bytes()
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header("Content-Type","font/woff2")
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(data)
            else:
                self.send_error(404)
        elif path.startswith("/file/"):
            self.serve_file()
        else:
            self.send_error(404, "Not Found")

    def do_POST(self):
        parsed_path=urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path)
        if parsed_path.path!="/":
            self.send_error(404)
            return
        content_length=int(self.headers.get('Content-Length',0))
        body=self.rfile.read(content_length).decode()
        params=urllib.parse.parse_qs(body)
        action=params.get('action',[None])[0]
        if action is None:
            self.send_error(400)
            return
        valid={"Reveal","Undo","End","Forgot","Hard","Good","Easy","Shutdown"}
        if action not in valid:
            self.send_response(422)
            self.send_header("Content-Type","text/plain")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(f"Failed to deserialize form body: action: unknown variant `{action}`, expected one of `Reveal`, `Undo`, `End`, `Forgot`, `Hard`, `Good`, `Easy`, `Shutdown`".encode())
            return
        server=self.server
        state=server.app_state
        with state['lock']:
            if action=="Reveal":
                state['revealed']=True
            elif action=="Undo":
                reviews=state['reviews']
                if reviews:
                    reviews.pop()
                    buried=set()
                    for rev in reviews:
                        h=rev[0]
                        for cs in state['cards']:
                            if cs['parsed'].hash==h:
                                fam=cs['parsed'].family_hash
                                if fam:
                                    buried.add(fam)
                    state['buried']=buried
                    if state['current_idx']>0:
                        state['current_idx']-=1
                    state['revealed']=False
            elif action in ("Forgot","Hard","Good","Easy"):
                idx=state['current_idx']
                if idx < len(state['cards']):
                    cs=state['cards'][idx]
                    now=datetime.datetime.now()
                    t_days=0
                    if cs['last_reviewed']:
                        try:
                            last_date=cs['last_reviewed'].date()
                            t_days=(datetime.date.today() - last_date).days
                            if t_days<0:
                                t_days=0
                        except:
                            t_days=0
                    new_stab, new_diff, interval_raw, interval_days, due_date = compute_fsrs(cs['stability'], cs['difficulty'], float(t_days), action)
                    cs['stability']=new_stab
                    cs['difficulty']=new_diff
                    cs['interval_days']=interval_days
                    cs['due_date']=due_date
                    cs['review_count']+=1
                    cs['last_reviewed']=now
                    if state['bury_siblings']:
                        fam=cs['parsed'].family_hash
                        if fam:
                            state['buried'].add(fam)
                    reviewed_at_str=now.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f")[:-3]
                    state['reviews'].append((cs['parsed'].hash, action, new_stab, new_diff, interval_raw, interval_days, due_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), reviewed_at_str))
                    state['current_idx']+=1
                    state['revealed']=False
            elif action=="End":
                save_session(state)
                state['current_idx']=len(state['cards'])
            elif action=="Shutdown":
                save_session(state)
                self.send_response(303)
                self.send_header("Location","/")
                self.end_headers()
                def shutdown():
                    time.sleep(0.1)
                    try:
                        server.shutdown()
                    except:
                        pass
                    os._exit(0)
                threading.Thread(target=shutdown, daemon=True).start()
                return
        self.send_response(303)
        self.send_header("Location","/")
        self.end_headers()

            card=cards[idx]

            def md_to_html(md_text):

                text=re.sub(r'!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\)', repl_img, md_text)
                def repl_md(m):
                    inner=m.group(1)
                    return f'<span class="math math-display">{inner}</span>'
                text=re.sub(r'\$\$(.+?)\$\$', repl_md, text, flags=re.DOTALL)
                def repl_mi(m):
                    inner=m.group(1)
                    return f'<span class="math math-inline">{inner}</span>'
                text=re.sub(r'\$(.+?)\$', repl_mi, text)
                text=re.sub(r'\*\*(.+?)\*\*', r'<strong>\1</strong>', text)
                text=re.sub(r'(?<!\*)\*(?!\*)(.+?)(?<!\*)\*(?!\*)', r'<em>\1</em>', text)
                text=re.sub(r'_(.+?)_', r'<em>\1</em>', text)

                blocks=text.split("\n\n")

                    else:

                return "\n".join(html_blocks)

            if card['parsed'].content_internal[0]=='basic':

            if not revealed:

    def serve_asset(self, asset_path, content_type):
        try:
            data=pathlib.Path(asset_path).read_bytes()
        except:
            data=pathlib.Path("/workspace")/asset_path
            if data.exists():
                data=data.read_bytes()
            else:
                self.send_error(404)
                return
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", content_type)
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)

    def serve_file(self):
        file_part=self.path[len("/file/"):]
        file_part=urllib.parse.unquote(file_part)
        server=self.server
        collection_dir=pathlib.Path(server.app_state['collection_dir'])
        requested=collection_dir / file_part
        try:
            canon=requested.resolve()
            dir_canon=collection_dir.resolve()
            if not str(canon).startswith(str(dir_canon)):
                self.send_error(404)
                return
            if not canon.is_file():
                self.send_error(404)
                return
            data=canon.read_bytes()
            import mimetypes
            mime,_=mimetypes.guess_type(str(canon))
            if mime is None:
                mime="application/octet-stream"
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", mime)
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(data)
        except:
            self.send_error(404)

def save_session(state):
    collection_dir=pathlib.Path(state['collection_dir'])
    db_p=collection_dir / "hashcards.db"
    try:
        conn=sqlite3.connect(db_p)
        ensure_db(conn)
        ended_at=datetime.datetime.now()
        ended_str=ended_at.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f")[:-3]
        conn.execute("UPDATE sessions SET ended_at=? WHERE session_id=?", (ended_str, state['session_id']))
        for rev in state['reviews']:
            h, grade, stab, diff, int_raw, int_days, due_date, reviewed_at = rev
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO reviews (session_id, card_hash, reviewed_at, grade, stability, difficulty, interval_raw, interval_days, due_date) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                (state['session_id'], h, reviewed_at, grade.lower(), stab, diff, int_raw, int_days, due_date)
            )
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE cards SET last_reviewed_at=?, stability=?, difficulty=?, interval_raw=?, interval_days=?, due_date=?, review_count=review_count+1 WHERE card_hash=?",
                (reviewed_at, stab, diff, int_raw, int_days, due_date, h)
            )
        conn.commit()
        conn.close()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"save error {e}", file=sys.stderr)
